checks.name: lights table (bridge from HUE_BRIDGE / HUE_APP_KEY)
checks.sql: SELECT name, room, is_on, brightness, color_temperature_kelvin FROM hue.main.lights ORDER BY name

checks.name: rooms and zones
checks.sql: SELECT name, kind, light_count FROM hue.main.rooms ORDER BY kind, name

checks.name: warmest room from sensors
checks.sql: SELECT room, temperature_c FROM hue.main.sensors WHERE kind = 'temperature' ORDER BY temperature_c DESC LIMIT 1

checks.name: set_room changes state
checks.sql: SELECT target_type, name, ok FROM hue.main.set_room('Kitchen', power := false)

checks.name: bulk set_lights from a query
checks.sql: SELECT target_id, ok FROM hue.main.set_lights((SELECT light_id FROM hue.main.lights WHERE color_mode IS NOT NULL), kelvin := 2700) ORDER BY target_id

checks.name: recall_scene
checks.sql: SELECT target_id FROM hue.main.recall_scene('Relax', room := 'Living room')
